note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The context is the room after the placeholder petition passed, along the configured path, into the prior-examination tray (a neutral two-slot tray marked only by a plain tab); the stations are abstract and fictional, of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy). One supplied datum is substituted on the tray's record plate: the supplied state (● authorization requested / ◆ decision supplied — equal weight). The old value is kept in the dock as 'was'; only the dependent state follows in the context (the decision's placeholder sheet — content never shown — in the tray's other slot, and the pins). No criterion, threshold, time limit, outcome (granted / refused / admitted) or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable (beforeStatus chooses which state comes first). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a request would add legal content (criteria) the inspection must not draw.
